rationale: Erta brings product management and quantitative analysis expertise from medical-robotics and SaaS, while Arfan has hands-on R&D experience in device design, hardware prototyping, and medical devices with strong embedded systems skills. Together they span the full product-to-prototype cycle—Erta's user-centered design and project management at Veeva can pair directly with Arfan's mechatronics and hardware-software integration work to move medical device concepts from concept to market.
intro_message: Erta Muca, meet Arfan — you're both in the SF Bay Area and have complementary expertise in medical devices: Erta's strength in product design and project management, and Arfan's prototyping and embedded systems background could make for a strong product-engineering collaboration.
